checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Counters, sink and stove are cleared of dishes, kettle, bottles, bags.

must.item: Original brown cabinets and beige tiles remain
must.why: Cabinets and tiles look the same; tiles slightly lighter but not replaced.

must.item: Layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match source
must.why: Right-hand second sink became a cooktop with two burners, and the counter shape changed slightly. Viewpoint is the same.

must.item: Cleared areas continuous and natural, no erasure marks
must.why: Counters look clean and seamless, with no remnants. The stove area is plausible but invented.

faults.what: The right-hand basin/drainboard with faucet was replaced by a black cooktop with two burners. This is a fixture change, not clutter removal. The tap on the right was removed.
The cooktop is hallucinated: the burners are oddly shaped and the surface looks generic.
The white kettle is removed as requested, but counter and tile tones are slightly brighter and smoother, with some AI smoothness.
A cabinet door near the top left has a slightly altered panel.

summary: The clutter is cleanly removed and the cabinets and tiles stay, but the right-hand second sink became an invented black cooktop, which changes the fixed fixtures.
